about: The catalog parity rules. scripts/catalog_parity.py reads this file, so change a sample size, tolerance, field list or priority here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.top_sellers: Rows of the Discovery product performance table, sorted by revenue, that go into the priority sample. Read by the SKILL.md call plan and by the script, which tags them top_seller.
notes.page_one_queries: How many of the highest-revenue searches to take page one from for the priority sample. Read by the SKILL.md call plan, not the script.
notes.page_size: Rows of each saved product grid that count as page one. Fetch grids with rows set to this; the script tags the first page_size products page_one.
notes.random_sample: Products to sample at random from Discovery for the headline rates, taken as 8 or more small pages (5 products each) spread across the catalog, plus about half as many Engagement-side items. Read by the SKILL.md call plan; the script reports the sample it was given.
notes.id_case_insensitive: Compare product IDs after trimming and lower-casing them. Set false if IDs that differ only by case are different products.
notes.fields: The compared fields: for each, the Discovery attributes and the Engagement item properties that may hold it. The first one with a value is used. --field NAME=DFIELD:EFIELD overrides one for a run.
notes.price_abs_tolerance: Prices (and sale prices) within this amount of each other match, in the catalog's currency.
notes.price_rel_tolerance_pct: Prices also match when within this percentage of the larger one. A price matches if it is within either tolerance.
notes.out_of_stock_values: Stock values that mean out of stock, compared lower-case. A boolean false, and a number of 0 or less, count too.
notes.in_stock_values: Stock values that mean in stock, compared lower-case. A boolean true, and a number above 0, count too.
notes.unknown_stock_values: Stock values that mean the status isn't known. A product whose stock is unknown on either side isn't compared on stock.
notes.url_ignore_scheme: Treat http:// and https:// as the same when comparing product URLs (images too).
notes.url_ignore_www: Treat www.example.com and example.com as the same host.
notes.url_ignore_query: Ignore the query string and fragment (tracking parameters, image sizes) when comparing URLs.
notes.priority: Priority of each check. missing_in_discovery drops to low when Engagement already marks the product out of stock, because recommendations usually filter it out. stock_out_on_site_in_engagement is a recommendation or email linking to a product the site can't sell.
notes.max_findings_listed: At most this many products with findings are listed in full, highest priority and revenue first; the rest are counted by check.
notes.confidence_z: The z value for the confidence interval around each mismatch rate (1.96 is 95%), using the Wilson score interval. The interval assumes independent draws: pages of adjacent products make it too narrow.
